item.title: Antoine Abou Slaiby at the Building Smart Forum KSA 2025. - Omrania
item.description: Omrania, a member of 10N, a collective created by Egis, had the privilege to contribute to buildingSMART Saudi Arabia, with our Head of Digital Delivery, Antoine Abou Slaiby, joining the panel discussion "BIM has come a long way" at Building Smart KSA 2025.

item.title: Arab Hindawi Represented Omrania and Egis at the Institution of Civil Engineers (ICE) UAE Learned Event - Omrania
item.description: We proudly participated in the Institution of Civil Engineers (ICE) UAE Learned Event held in Dubai, where Arab Hindawi, Deputy Head of the Infrastructure Department, joined the panel discussion on “Bridging Communities Through Mobility Solutions.” Arab contributed to an engaging dialogue on advancing urban connectivity and sustainable infrastructure, highlighting the importance of collaboration across disciplines and regions.

item.title: Omrania Announces New Corporate Principals to Strengthen Design and Operational Leadership
item.description: Omrania Appoints Mahmoud Abughazal, Fadi Saroufim, and Dr. Rukn Eldeen as Corporate Principals to Lead Design, Operations, and Special Projects Across Saudi Arabia

item.title: Omrania Won Architecture Firm of the Year 2025
item.description: We are proud to announce that Omrania has been awarded the 𝗔𝗿𝗰𝗵𝗶𝘁𝗲𝗰𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗲 𝗙𝗶𝗿𝗺 𝗼𝗳 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗬𝗲𝗮𝗿 at the Construction Week Saudi Awards 2025.

item.title: Antoine Abou Slaiby at the Smart Built Environment Forum (SBEF) KSA 2025
item.description: Omrania at the Built Environment Forum (SBEF) KSA 2025 at the Riyadh Marriott, where Antoine Abou Slaiby, Head of Digital Delivery at Omrania, represented the firm as a panelist in a high-level discussion on the future of intelligent buildings. Bringing together leaders from across the built environment, the forum provided a focused platform to explore how digital innovation is advancing operational performance in line with Saudi Arabia’s Vision 2030.​

item.title: Omrania at Big 5 Construct Saudi 2026: Exploring Design Leadership at Scale
item.description: Mai Jaber joined industry peers at the Big 5 Construct Saudi – Architecture Leaders Forum 2026 in Riyadh, discussing design leadership and the architect’s role in shaping complex developments.

item.title: Alia Centofanti on Future Workspaces in Saudi Arabia
item.description: Interior Design Director Alia Centofanti represented Omrania on the panel “Future Workspaces in Saudi Arabia: Global Ambition, Local Capability,” sharing insights on culture-driven, ergonomic workplaces in Riyadh

item.title: Omrania at Lighting Innovation Summit 2026
item.description: Ajmal Abdul Vakeel, Principal Electrical Engineer at Omrania, joined industry leaders at the Lighting Innovation Summit 2026 in Riyadh to discuss intelligent lighting, energy efficiency, and technology integration shaping the future of smart cities.
